# csa: Credit support annex (from CSV)

*Generated by `tools/mrloader/kind_docs.py` from the kind's contract, its mapping file and its sample: do not edit; change the mapping or the contract and run it again.*

## 1. What it is and who reads it

The credit support annexes, one row each: thresholds, minimum transfer amounts, independent amount, margin frequency and period of risk.

Collateral terms: thresholds, minimum transfer, eligible collateral and haircuts.

- **Contract:** `modules/banking/packs/counterparty-risk/contracts/csa.contract.yaml` (pack `counterparty-risk`, class `fundamental`), key `CSA_ID`.
- **Mapping:** `tools/mrloader/kinds/csa.yaml` (source `canonical`); wave 2 of the CSV loaders.
- **Grain:** One row per credit support annex per business date, keyed by CSA_ID.

## 2. The command

```bash
python3 tools/mrloader/csv_load.py --kind csa --csv FILE --child ELIGIBLE=FILE --date YYYY-MM-DD --dry-run   # check; write nothing
python3 tools/mrloader/csv_load.py --kind csa --csv FILE --child ELIGIBLE=FILE --date YYYY-MM-DD --inbox     # convert and hand to the data inbox
python3 tools/mrloader/csv_load.py --kind csa --template                                       # the header and an example row
```

In a day file: `csa: {csv: "FILE", child: {ELIGIBLE: "FILE"}}`. A bank's own column names: a mapping file of its own, given with `--mapping FILE`.

## 3. The CSV, column by column

The file's format: delimiter `,`, encoding `utf-8`, decimal `.`, thousands `,`, dates `YYYY-MM-DD` (declared in the mapping's `csv:` block over `kinds/shared/csv.yaml`; never guessed). Column names compare upper-cased, other characters as `_`.

| Column | Required | Field | Rule | Description | Decision |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `CSA_ID` | yes | `CSA_ID` | upper-cased, other characters `-`; prefixed `CSA-` unless it has it; text, kept as written | The record's id (the business key) |  |
| `MARGIN_TYPE` | yes | `MARGIN_TYPE` | as written | Variation margin (VM) covers today's value; initial margin (IM) covers how it may move before a default is closed out. | VM, VM + IM ... |
| `THRESHOLD_US` | yes | `THRESHOLD_US` | a number (decimal `.`) | The exposure the counterparty may have to the bank before the bank must post collateral. |  |
| `THRESHOLD_THEM` | yes | `THRESHOLD_THEM` | a number (decimal `.`) | The exposure the bank accepts before the counterparty must post collateral. |  |
| `MTA`, then `MTA_US` | yes | `MTA` | a whole number | The smallest collateral movement either side may call. |  |
| `INDEPENDENT_AMOUNT` | no | `INDEPENDENT_AMOUNT` | empty: `0`; a number (decimal `.`) | Collateral posted up front, whatever the exposure. |  |
| `FREQUENCY` | yes | `FREQUENCY` | as written | How often margin is called. | Daily, Weekly ... |
| `CSA_CURRENCY` | yes | `CSA_CURRENCY` | upper-cased | The currency the CSA's amounts are in (thresholds, minimum transfer amounts, independent amount) and calls are made in. |  |
| `MTA_US` | yes | `MTA_US` | a number (decimal `.`) | The minimum transfer amount when the bank delivers collateral. |  |
| `MTA_THEM` | yes | `MTA_THEM` | a number (decimal `.`) | The minimum transfer amount when the counterparty delivers collateral. |  |
| `MARGIN_FREQUENCY_DAYS` | yes | `MARGIN_FREQUENCY_DAYS` | a whole number | How often a margin call may be made, in business days (1 for a daily CSA); FREQUENCY says it in words. |  |
| `MPOR_DAYS` | yes | `MPOR_DAYS` | a whole number | The margin period of risk, in business days, assumed between the last margin received and closing out a defaulted counterparty. | the margin period of risk, business days |
| `LEGAL_ENTITY` | yes | `LEGAL_ENTITY` | upper-cased, other characters `-`; prefixed `LE-` unless it has it; text, kept as written | The bank legal entity the CSA is signed by (one CSA per agreement and legal entity, decision 9). |  |
| `AGREEMENT` | yes | `AGREEMENT` | upper-cased, other characters `-`; prefixed `AGR-` unless it has it; text, kept as written | The master agreement the CSA belongs to: an AGREEMENT_ID of the agreement kind (AGR-…). |  |
| `COUNTERPARTY` | yes | `COUNTERPARTY` | upper-cased, other characters `-`; prefixed `CP-` unless it has it; text, kept as written | The counterparty of the CSA: a COUNTERPARTY_ID of the core pack's counterparty kind (CP-…). |  |

**The child file `ELIGIBLE`** (`--child ELIGIBLE=FILE`): one row per element of `ELIGIBLE`, joined to its record by `CSA_ID`; a record with no row: kept; never twice the same ASSET.

| Column | Required | Field | Rule | Description | Decision |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `ASSET` | yes | `ELIGIBLE[].ASSET` | as written | An asset the counterparty may deliver as collateral. |  |
| `HAIRCUT` | yes | `ELIGIBLE[].HAIRCUT` | a fraction (0.05) | The share taken off the asset's value when it is counted as collateral. | a fraction: 0.02 is 2% |

```csv
CSA-ALDERSHOT-TRUST,VM,10000000,10000000,500000,0,Daily,USD,500000,500000,1,10,LE-CDADMM-H4705,AGR-ALDERSHOT-TRUST-ISDA,CP-ALDERSHOT-TRUST
```


## 5. What is not loaded

| Name | What | Why |
|---|---|---|
| `NETTING_SETS` | a column of this name | the netting sets name their CSA; the reverse list is derived |
| `COLLATERAL_BALANCES` | a column of this name | the balances name their CSA; the reverse list is derived |
| `NETTING_SETS` | derived | the reverse of the netting set's CSA link, derived by Drishti; a master file does not carry it |
| `COLLATERAL_BALANCES` | derived | the reverse of the collateral balance's CSA link, derived by Drishti; a master file does not carry it |

## 6. Checks

- **A rejected row:** `on-reject: refuse` (any rejected row refuses the whole kind: fix the file and run again). A duplicate key always refuses it.
- **Unique:** `CSA_ID` per business date.
- **Link** `LEGAL_ENTITY` to `legal-entity`: policy `warn` (mr_run.py checks it against the day's `legal-entity` file, else `--against`; a target found nowhere is *not checked*).
- **Link** `AGREEMENT` to `agreement`: policy `warn` (mr_run.py checks it against the day's `agreement` file, else `--against`; a target found nowhere is *not checked*).
- **Link** `COUNTERPARTY` to `counterparty`: policy `warn` (mr_run.py checks it against the day's `counterparty` file, else `--against`; a target found nowhere is *not checked*).
- **Link** `NETTING_SETS` to `netting-set`: policy `warn` (mr_run.py checks it against the day's `netting-set` file, else `--against`; a target found nowhere is *not checked*).
- **Link** `COLLATERAL_BALANCES` to `collateral-balance`: policy `warn` (mr_run.py checks it against the day's `collateral-balance` file, else `--against`; a target found nowhere is *not checked*).

Reject codes it can give: `MISSING_REQUIRED`, `BAD_INTEGER`, `BAD_NUMBER`, `EXCEL_NUMBER_ID`, `BAD_ENUM`, `BAD_PATTERN`, `DUPLICATE_KEY`, `EXCEL_ERROR`, `FORMULA`, `BAD_ROW_SHAPE`.
Each line of `<kind>.<date>.rejects.csv` gives FILE, ROW (as a spreadsheet shows it), KEY, COLUMN, FIELD, VALUE, REASON, WHY, FIX.

## 7. Before and after

- **Load first:** `agreement`.
- **Then:** `netting-set`.

## 8. Repeat, restate, remove

- **Again for the same date:** the same command; the date's `csa` rows are replaced as a whole (`mode: replace`).
- **Restate a past date:** run with that `--date`; to change one row, send the whole file again.
- **Remove the date:** `python3 tools/drishti.py lake delete --lake LAKE --kind csa --date YYYY-MM-DD --dry-run` (then without `--dry-run`).

## 9. Spreadsheet warnings

- `CSA_ID`: an id: export the column as text (a long id saved as a number, `2.00001E+11`, is refused; leading zeros lost are not detectable without `pad:`)
- `LEGAL_ENTITY`: an id: export the column as text (a long id saved as a number, `2.00001E+11`, is refused; leading zeros lost are not detectable without `pad:`)
- `AGREEMENT`: an id: export the column as text (a long id saved as a number, `2.00001E+11`, is refused; leading zeros lost are not detectable without `pad:`)
- `COUNTERPARTY`: an id: export the column as text (a long id saved as a number, `2.00001E+11`, is refused; leading zeros lost are not detectable without `pad:`)

## 10. Source variants

None shipped. A source with other column names gets a mapping file `kinds/csa.<source>.yaml` (or a site's own, by `--mapping`).
